chesttracker.explain._comment: Explanations shown when you hover a status or note (or tap Show warnings). Edit freely; an empty or missing entry shows no explanation, and a resource pack can fill it in.
chesttracker.explain.status.missing: Should be here but isn't. It may have wandered, been moved, broken, or gone through a portal - the tracker can't tell which. Check it is really gone before marking it destroyed.
chesttracker.explain.status.likely_destr: Likely died or was destroyed. Check before marking it destroyed.
chesttracker.explain.status.died: Likely killed: seen dying, or vanished beside you and dropped its items. Check first, then mark it dead.
chesttracker.explain.status.picked_up: Gone from where it stood and auto-trashed. Shulkers keep contents when broken, so most likely picked up with everything inside. Check your inventory.
chesttracker.explain.status.destroyed: Gone from where it stood (the chunk is loaded, so it really is gone) and auto-trashed. If a container is placed back there, it returns as never opened.
chesttracker.explain.went_through_portal: Vanished beside a portal - it most likely went through. Whether it survived the trip is unknown.
chesttracker.explain.chest_removed: Seen without its chest. Dropping the chest drops everything inside, so the remembered contents are likely gone.
chesttracker.explain.container_changed: A different kind of container now stands here. The old contents are kept until you open it again.
chesttracker.explain.imported: Imported from Chest Tracker, which did not record slots, so items are listed in order from the first slot. Open it once to learn the real layout.
chesttracker.explain.reappeared: Thought destroyed (or in the trash), but spotted again.
chesttracker.explain.hopper_below: A hopper underneath can pull items out of it over time.
chesttracker.explain.fed_by_hopper: A hopper points into it and can add items over time.
chesttracker.explain.processes_items: Furnaces and brewing stands change their contents as they run.
chesttracker.explain.moves_items: Hoppers and hopper minecarts pull in and pass on items by themselves.
chesttracker.explain.over_hopper: This minecart sits on a rail above a hopper, which can empty it.
chesttracker.explain.unknown_contents: Contains something you did not see go in. Servers only say which slots of a jukebox or chiseled bookshelf are filled (not with what), and many never reveal a decorated pot's contents - only items you put in yourself are tracked.
chesttracker.explain.unread_book: A lectern book the tracker hasn't seen. Open it once and it is remembered and searchable.
chesttracker.explain.stale: Not opened in the last %s days on this server. Not an error: a hopper may have emptied it, or another player changed it. Days you weren't on don't count.
chesttracker.explain.in_trash: Trashed by you. Hidden from search; forgotten in %s days unless restored.
chesttracker.bulk.delete_body: They will be forgotten for good. This cannot be undone.
chesttracker.explain.profession_changed: A different profession than when you last traded, so its offers changed. Trade again to refresh them.
chesttracker.explain.leveled_up: Leveled up since you last looked; new offers unlocked. Trade to refresh them.
chesttracker.explain.leaves_by_itself: Wandering traders only stay a while, then leave on their own.
chesttracker.explain.trades.changes: Prices and stock as last seen; they drift with demand, discounts, restocks, and vary per account.
chesttracker.grid.hint: %s kinds of items, most first. Tap one to see where it is, middle-click for the nearest
